$comment: P0a ground truth: kraken-cli v0.4.1 clap-derive analysis (source tarball via codeload, 2026-09-13). Sandbox cannot run the binary (release-assets host blocked); P0b (scripts/kraken_p0_verify.sh) confirms on target box.

global_flags.futures_url: --futures-url (env KRAKEN_FUTURES_URL) -- demo-futures mechanism, no --sandbox/--demo flag exists

error_contract.json_mode: stdout carries a JSON error envelope {error, message, ...} (src/output/json.rs render_error), exit 1

order.buy: kraken order buy <PAIR> <VOL> [--type <market|limit|...>] [--price P] [--price2 P2] [--leverage N] [--reduce-only] [--timeinforce GTC|IOC|GTD] [--userref I|--cl-ord-id ID] [--oflags FLAGS] [--close-ordertype T --close-price P [--close-price2 P2]] [--deadline RFC3339] [--validate] -o json
order.batch: kraken order batch <JSON_FILE> [--pair P] [--deadline RFC3339] [--validate] -o json  (2-15 orders)
order.amend: kraken order amend (--txid T|--cl-ord-id ID) [--order-qty Q] [--limit-price P] [--trigger-price P] [--post-only] [--deadline D] -o json
order.edit: kraken order edit <TXID> [--volume V] [--price P] [--pair P] -o json  (cancel+replace)
order.cancel_batch: kraken order cancel-batch <TXID...> [--cl-ord-ids ID...] -o json  (max 50 total)

market_top_level.server_time: kraken server-time -o json  (Exchange-Clock via CLI, no REST exception needed)
market_top_level.orderbook: kraken orderbook <PAIR> [--count N, default 25, max 500] -o json
market_top_level.trades: kraken trades <PAIR> [--since TS] [--count N, default 1000] -o json

paper_spot.init: kraken paper init [NAME] [--capital/--balance 10000] [--currency USD] [--fee-rate F] [--slippage-rate S]
paper_spot.manage: kraken paper orders | cancel <PAPER-ID> | cancel-all | history | balance [NAME] | status | reset

futures.trade: kraken futures order buy|sell <SYM> <SIZE> [--type limit] [--price P] [--stop-price P] [--trigger-signal mark|index|last] [--client-order-id ID] [--reduce-only] -o json

ws_spot.channels: kraken ws ticker|trades <PAIRS...> | book <PAIRS...> [--depth 10|25|100|500|1000] | ohlc <PAIRS...> [--interval M] | instrument [PAIRS...] | executions | balances | level3 <PAIRS...>  (auth channels use configured credentials; no --token flag exists)
ws_spot.methods: kraken ws add-order|amend-order|cancel-order|cancel-all|cancel-after|batch-add|batch-cancel|ping  (auth, one-shot; REST order-path stays the NIO standard)

earn.cmds: kraken earn allocate|deallocate <STRATEGY_ID> <AMOUNT> | allocate-status|deallocate-status <STRATEGY_ID> | strategies [--asset A] | allocations

commands.misc: kraken auth ... | mcp [-s services] [--allow-dangerous] | shell | setup | session ... | workspace ... | record/replay/streamd/tape/lab ...
